name: Mexican Black Bean Tacos
ingredients: 100 g firm tofu, crumbled and spiced
½ tomato and ¼ onion, diced
1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp paprika, ¼ tsp chilli powder
steps: Pan-toast the tofu with the oil, half the spices and salt for 5 minutes until dry and golden.
Warm the beans with the remaining spices and 2 tbsp water for 4 minutes; mash lightly.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds per side.
Fill with beans, tofu, cabbage, tomato, onion and avocado.
Finish with lime juice, coriander and salsa.
note: Corn tortillas are lower in carbohydrate than flour ones; beans and tofu carry the protein.
